targets.data: the 2023 pre-trial's destructive samples (DestructiveHarvest.xlsx, All Data) on 18 and 29 September and 9 November 2023, per light zone and EC treatment, means per plant
targets.exclusion: an organ dried heavier than it weighed fresh is no target, nor is its plant's dry weight above ground

objective: decision 0076: the sum over the targets of ln((predicted + c) / (measured + c))², c half the smallest mean above zero of each quantity
drivers: drivers.py's 2023 series, one per light zone, with the sha256 drivers.json gives
initial_state: the 2023 transplants per plant (harness.transplants), scaled to the density at transplanting; carbohydrate taken for dry matter one for one; the buffer at c_buf_min, 1 g CH₂O m⁻², the least below which the model's growth stops (the objective at the published parameters: 173.3, against 210.1 started empty)

method.scaling: each parameter mapped linearly from its bounds to [0, 1]
method.start: the published values, each held within its bounds

fixed: every other parameter at its published value

parameters.name: sla
parameters.why: The specific leaf area (m² mg⁻¹ CH₂O), the screen's largest change (134.9 of 173.3). The pre-trial measured it: 251 to 352 cm² g⁻¹ of dry leaves after transplanting, 536 at it, against the published 266 cm² g⁻¹ CH₂O.

parameters.name: alpha
parameters.why: Photons to electrons, the light the leaves turn into growth. Screen: 87.1. The stomatal CO₂ ratio and the CO₂ compensation's temperature coefficient move the objective the same way (87.1 each); one light-use parameter is calibrated.

parameters.name: t_end_sum
parameters.why: The temperature sum to a fully generative crop (°C day): fruit growth's onset, as n_ff is Reduced-State TOMGRO's. The published value is about 50 days at 20 °C, and the pre-trial's dwarf crop set fruit within 25; but the screen moves it the other way (147.2 at 1.25 times, 200.0 at 0.8), while the published leaves are short of their area. Its bounds allow both. Screen: 26.6.

parameters.name: rg_fruit
parameters.why: The fruit's potential growth (mg CH₂O m⁻² s⁻¹), its sink beside the leaves' and stem's: with the supply calibrated through alpha, it sets the share of growth to fruit, 67 % of the pre-trial's dry weight above ground by 9 November. Screen: 33.8.

not_chosen: t_can24_max (63.4), rg_leaf (55.5: the fruit's sink is calibrated against it instead), k1_par (46.4), c_leaf_m (42.9), and eta_co2_air_stom and c_gamma (with alpha).
